title: +PROFESSIONAL AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT SKILLS
description: Introduces and applies career readiness competencies for the School of Public Policy majors.  Illustrates how students’ training in Economics, Political Science, Public Policy, or Sociology and related experiences connect to career readiness and career advancement skills. Emphasizes the application of life-long career development concepts by creating career-relevant artifacts. Engages students in hands-on career-related experiences and activities. Adapts assignments to meet students’ professional needs, whether they are looking for an internship, job, or applying to law school or graduate school.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CORE 100, 300, LA 100, 300, BA 100, 300, ENGR 110, 110H, 310, SCI 100, 300, ED 100, 300 or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CORE 100, CORE 300, LA 100, LA 300, BA 100, BA 300, ENGR 110, ENGR 110H, ENGR 310, SCI 100, SCI 300, ED 100 and ED 300.
